detail.longDescription: Given the following example zod schema z.object({ foo: z.int().min(5), bar: z.int().min(1) }) I want to make sure that bar must have a maximum of foo - 1 . I tried to use .refine() for this .refine( ({ foo, bar }) => bar <= foo - 1, { error: ({ input }) => { const { foo } = input; // input is unknown, not fully typed return `There is a maximum of ${foo - 1}.` }, path: ["bar"], }, ) but the problem is that the issue.input field of the error function parameter is of type unknown . In my case I need fully typed fields and I don't want to cast them. So I tried .superRefine() instead .superRefine((data, ctx) => { const { foo, bar } = data; if (bar > foo - 1) { ctx.addIssue({ code: "too_big", message: `There is a maximum of ${foo - 1}.`, path: ["bar"], }); } }); which seems to work but requires more manual work. Is there a way to get a typed issue.input field when using the refine function? Or do I have to use superRefine then?
